text:
All 10 tests pass. I made three surgical fixes to `collkit.py`:

1. **`unique`** — replaced `list(set(items))` (which destroys order) with a `seen`-set + ordered-output loop, preserving first-occurrence order.

2. **`partition`** — swapped the return from `no, yes` to `yes, no`, so matches come first as documented.

3. **`windows`** — changed `range(0, len(items) - k)` to `range(0, len(items) - k + 1)`, so the final window of length `k` is included.
